stem:
Meera walks from her home to the school library. She covers a distance of 240 m in 4 minutes, walking at the same pace the whole way.
What is her speed, expressed with the correct unit?

teacher.key_rationale: Time must be in seconds: 4 min = 240 s. Speed = distance ÷ time = 240 m ÷ 240 s = 1 m/s. Option A (60 m/s) traps students who divide by 4 without converting minutes; C (960 m/s) traps multiplication; D pairs the right number with a wrong unit.
